    Tits forms of representation-finite pieces #

    For a connected representation-finite convex piece, every indecomposable module is directing (directing_piece), hence rigid. So the Tits form of any family of relations generating those of the cover is weakly positive (one_le_titsF_of_repFin), and its positive vectors of value at most one are dimension vectors of bricks respecting the cover (exists_brick_of_repFin).

    The Tits form of a connected representation-finite piece is weakly positive.

    Roots of the Tits form of a connected representation-finite piece are bricks.
